title: Directors' resolution in writing
summary: The directors approve a financial year's statements and authorise a director to sign them.

paragraphs: We, being all the directors of {{.Company.Name}}, pass the following resolutions in writing, as the company's constitution allows.

sections.heading: Resolved
items: That the financial statements of the company for the financial year ended {{.F.fy_end}} be approved.
That any one director be authorised to sign the statement by the directors and the financial statements on behalf of the board.
